level_check_rereview.checked: The level check's replacement was applied verbatim (prompt, three options, evidence, explanation). Prompt 'Karim gaat een woning huren. Wie maken samen de afspraken in het huurcontract?' is 13 words (limit 20), situation first and question second, plain A2 words. Key A 'De huurder en de verhuurder.' is stated by the fact text ('de afspraken tussen de huurder en de verhuurder', now the evidence and a verbatim substring of the unchanged text) and by the cited page, re-fetched 2026-09-10 with curl (HTTP 200 at the cited address, no redirect): 'In een huurcontract staan de afspraken tussen u en uw verhuurder. Bijvoorbeeld hoe hoog de huur is.' and, in its list of points, 'uw naam; de naam van de verhuurder; ... uw handtekening en de handtekening van de verhuurder'. B 'De huurder en de gemeente.' is false by that page (the gemeente is not a party) and plausible because indicator 3.1.1 says first housing often comes via the gemeente; C 'De verhuurder en de notaris.' is false (no notary on the page) and plausible because a notary belongs to buying a house. Options 5/5/5 words, all of the form 'De X en de Y.', no polarity, no hedge; 'huurder' recurs in B and 'verhuurder' in C, so no prompt word recurs only in the key. The explanation names both distractors and says why they fail; its clause 'een notaris hoort bij het kopen van een huis' is not on the cited page but is general knowledge and agrees with the woningcorporatie explanation in the same batch ('een notaris regelt de koopakte'). Eindterm 3.1.1 'weet wat een huurcontract inhoudt' still fits: the question now tests who the parties are instead of the word. The 'evidence' field above (which quotes the page for the previous definitional question) remains true of the page.

The explanation's added sentence differs from the level check's proposal in one word: 'de gemeente gaat niet over de huurverhoging' instead of '... de huurprijs'. The reviser is right. The cited page, re-fetched 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200 at the cited address, no redirect; its title now reads 'Wanneer kan ik terecht bij de Huurcommissie, de gemeente en de kantonrechter?'), says 'Als uw huurprijs te hoog is, kunt u ook bij de gemeente terecht.', so 'de gemeente gaat niet over de huurprijs' would contradict the page, while the annual increase is assigned to the Huurcommissie in both the sociale/middenhuur and the vrije-sector paragraphs ('bent u het niet eens met de hoogte van de huur of de jaarlijkse huurverhoging? ... kijk dan wanneer u de Huurcommissie kunt inschakelen'; 'Voor geschillen over de jaarlijkse huurverhoging ... kunt u nog wel naar de Huurcommissie'). Key C is stated by the fact text ('kan naar de Huurcommissie'; evidence unchanged and verbatim) and by the page; eindterm 3.1.2 'onterechte huurverhoging' fits exactly. 'Huur' still occurs only in the key, which is inherent to the institution's name and was accepted by the level check; the point of the request, distractors that a tenant actually considers, is met. level_check_rereview.checked: Option C 'Bij het alarmnummer 112.' replaces 'Bij de energieleverancier.', which eindterm 3.2.1 ('weet hoe hij een storing meldt bij de leverancier van de nutsvoorziening', Staatscourant 2024-15802 XML fetched 2026-09-10) made defensible; the explanation is the level check's text verbatim; the imageBrief now says the houses across the street are dark too, with no lit windows anywhere in the street, as the level check asked. Key B is stated by the fact text ('Een storing van gas of stroom meldt u bij de netbeheerder'; evidence unchanged and verbatim) and by the cited page, re-fetched 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200 at the cited address, no redirect): 'Bij vragen over gas- of stroomstoringen moet u bij de netbeheerder zijn. De netbeheerders hebben 1 landelijk storingsnummer: 0800-9009.' A 'Bij de gemeente.' is not named on the page (plausible: the gemeente is a newcomer's default public body). C is clearly wrong for a power cut: 112 is for urgent help where every second counts (government.nl page cited by the noodnummer card, re-fetched 2026-09-10: 'for when you need urgent help, for instance when your life is in immediate danger, or if someone is seriously injured ... or if you have witnessed a serious crime'); a street without electricity is none of these; plausible because 112 is the one number every newcomer knows. Options 3/3/4 words, three 'Bij ...' phrases, key not the longest, no prompt word in any option. The explanation refutes both current distractors (gemeente, 112) and still mentions the energieleverancier, which is useful because the eindterm names the leverancier. The clause '112 is alleen voor levensgevaar' was checked against the noodnummer card (A2:knm:batch003-noodnummer:1: 'Het alarmnummer 112 is voor spoed wanneer iedere seconde telt, bijvoorbeeld bij brand, direct levensgevaar of een ernstig ongeluk.') and against eindterm 4.3.2 ('Weet dat bij levensbedreigende situaties het nummer 112 moet worden gebeld'): it is the eindterm's own grain, the card's examples are life-threatening situations and the card's key (a house fire, 112) stays consistent with it, so it is not misleading. It is narrower than the government.nl page, which also names witnessing a serious crime, but that is not the tested fact; if the coordinator prefers the card's wording, the drop-in clause is 'en 112 is alleen voor spoed, als elke seconde telt' (not requested). Coordinator note 1 (the netbeheerder/leverancier tension) is resolved by this edit. The current drawing (lit windows across the street) is not answer-relevant; the picture must be regenerated from the new brief.

The three signals the level check named are gone: the key is no longer the shortest (B is as long, C longer), no longer the only hedged option (C is qualified by 'maar ... niet meer') and no longer the only 'Ja' (C). Key A is stated by the fact text ('In Nederland kunt u meestal zelf uw huisarts kiezen'; evidence unchanged and verbatim) and by the cited page, re-fetched 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200 at the cited address, no redirect): 'Het is meestal mogelijk om zelf uw huisarts te kiezen en ook om van huisarts te veranderen.'
